A.name: 旧产品入口最小退役

B.name: 旧入口与 Tauri 专属支撑完整退役
B.tradeoff: Produces the cleanest single-product tree. Generic release-audit capabilities are retained, but Tauri-only packaging and evidence scripts are removed because release work is outside the current objective.

preconditions: The owner approves exactly option A or option B.
All listed paths resolve inside E:\Arforge-Agent and no target is a reparse point escaping the workspace.
The 191-method ownership audit passes with 61 Python capability methods, 130 TypeScript-native methods, and all 58 semantic replacements covered by source-level UI gates.
Workflow Graph PostgreSQL migration is applied and verified, or an owner-approved database exception is recorded.
A reversible profile/export archive and a verified PostgreSQL backup exist before retirement.
The current Electron Desktop, TypeScript CLI, and Python capability service are not running from any target scheduled for deletion.

execution.method: Move exact approved paths to the Windows Recycle Bin after resolving and validating each absolute path.
execution.partialFailure: Stop immediately, report the exact path that failed, and do not continue with documentation changes.

postconditions: Every approved deletion target is absent and every explicitly retained target is present.
No active command, manifest, test, or user guide references a deleted entry point.
The full App, Core, and Python regression suites pass with zero failures.
Electron Desktop cold-starts and accepts native mouse and keyboard interaction.
CLI model selection and one real model response succeed.
CLI and Desktop observe the same PostgreSQL-backed session.
PostgreSQL backup and isolated restore comparison report zero row differences.
Brand, source-path, reparse-point, first-party license, and private-package audits remain clean.
